capabilities: Create paginated handwritten notes with paper templates and bookmarks
Draw on an infinite canvas with text, strokes, cards, groups, and connections
Annotate PDFs with handwriting, text search, and excerpts
Keep a separate scratchpad with its own viewport and undo history
Export drawings to PDF, PNG, or an editable .inkpack backup
extras: Simplified Chinese interface; runs offline with bundled fonts and PDF resources; the approximately 46 MB main script exceeds Obsidian Sync Standard's 5 MB file limit, so that plan requires installing the plugin separately on each device.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in handwriting layer for paginated pages, infinite canvases, or PDF annotation.
summary: Handwriting and drawing plugin that adds paginated ink notes, an infinite canvas, PDF annotation, and a separate scratchpad.
